# C3: Rules and findings

A checklist pack is a set of rules a gate applies to a change: deterministic checks over the change's artifacts and the catalog, and bounded AI checks that must cite evidence. A finding is one result, stored as `openspec/changes/<change>/review/<gate>/<round>/<finding-id>.yaml`. Blocking findings stop a hand-off until fixed or waived by the stage owner; gaps need a fix or a recorded reason; risks and ideas never block.

Specification version 0.1.0.

| Version        | Value |
| -------------- | ----- |
| Schema version | 1     |

## ChecklistPack

Where: `org-pack/checklists/<name>.yaml`.

A checklist file: one pack of rules.
